description: Search the 195 UX/UI principles by free text, part, difficulty or tags. Returns the matching principles with slug, title, code, part name and summary, plus the total count. Use it to find which principles apply to a design question before calling get_principle.

limit.description: Maximum number of principles to return. Defaults to 10.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

part.description: Restrict to one part of the catalogue, by id or name (e.g., "part-1", "Foundations"). Call list_principles to see the parts.

query.description: Free-text query matched against title, slug, summary and tags (e.g., "form validation", "loading states", "choice overload").

tags.description: Restrict to principles carrying every listed tag (e.g., ["forms", "errors"]).

name: search_principles
title: Search principles
